deliveroo.source: Deliveroo_Master_Consolidation.xlsx — Weekly Summary. + ops from Weekly Summary sheet

issues: Covers rose by 117 (6.21%) week on week and spend per head rose by £0.49 (2.56%); SPH is better than last week but much lower than previous weeks and last month, because £5 and free ramen guests mostly order nothing else, not even drinks.
Sales rose by £3,448.36 (9%) week on week and were £6,251.66 (17.61%) above target.
Saturday was the highest sales day to date, with many tourists and growing demand for hot ramen; without discounts, sales would have been £45,699.74.
Labour was BOH 13.55% and FOH 10.83%; excluding discounts, labour was 22.19% (BOH 12.32%, FOH 9.8%) on the Kobas figures.

Deliveroo: two of four disputed orders were accepted, but no picture could be found for one order; a 2 star review (extra broth packaging, no spoon) was answered with a £7.50 voucher, and a 5 star review said the ramen was okay and the sushi great.

Google rating is 4.7 (4.75), with 52 five star reviews (more showing on notifications, and some glitches with replies), 7 four star reviews (mostly complimenting FOH service) and 2 one star reviews from KKKW that may not be genuine.
The only negative review on the highest sales day said the place was crowded and the food took too long.

BOH development: Razzak will begin training in the hot section; Pallavi, Mohammed and Ram are in hot section development, with Pallavi doing half shifts on donburi and sides; Aniket has been hired as a new KP and will start cross training and hot section training soon.
With the busy season coming, new FOH hires are needed; Tamara is not coming back, the Talent Funnel has been reviewed and lots of trials will be invited to pick the best.
A new BOH kitchen assistant vacancy is open but has no candidates yet.

Maintenance log: drainage cleaning done (high, Ross); door stopper (medium to low, Ross); Zen 10 pest job (high, no owner listed); ramen section leak (medium, Francheska); draft beer (medium, Ross); VIP area leak (medium to high); dishwasher area leak.

Upcoming: 50% off first Slerp orders over £20 (excluding drinks and frozen ramen), with the Slerp promotion running Friday 6 to Sunday 8 November and materials due 4 November; The Fork 30% offer (Imi and Peter); and a Monday to Friday lunch offer.

Areas for improvement: controlling maintenance and maintenance checks; the Chatha cleaners only come once a month, so the team must take over; broth will be tasted before opening and before the evening shift (some staff are vegan or halal); and constant training and Kaizen.
The printer is working again: allergen guides, the new supplier schedule and recipes have been printed.
Downstairs gets cold when the door is open, so heating will be needed in winter.
A booking for 17 teenagers left one chair broken.
A Soho booking enquiry received a response through the B2B channel.

The 117 cover rise was put down to the loyalty app and colder weather; £5 ramen vouchers represented about £1,500 of potential revenue, and the site projects £50,000 weeks in the first two weeks of December.

Delivery: 91 orders last week generated £2,790.39 gross with only two complaints, helped by the delivery radius being extended on Friday; Ziang Lin projects £3,000 to £4,000 of delivery sales this week, with about 200 orders expected.
Delivery prep time improved from 15 to 14 minutes against a target of 13 minutes or less.
Food stock variance was 1.4% and wet stock variance 1.2%.
To stop delivery spills, Ziang Lin demonstrated a new packing method: remove the air from takeaway bags and staple them shut with the ticket.

On the 2 star missing spoon review, Ziang Lin said spoons are not needed unless requested; Kaitlin Docherty suggested including one, which Ziang Lin accepted on condition that boxes are not stockpiled in the limited space.
£5 online order vouchers and loyalty app flyers (images in the South England chat) must go in every delivery and Slerp bag.
A supplier misread unit sizes on Marian's order of 1 pack of vegan bacon and 5 packs of beef, delivering 17 full boxes of vegan bacon and 1 box of beef; Ross is arranging a redelivery on 13/10.
Weekly admin was completed except payroll, which was uncertain.
Razzak will train on the hot section ahead of Marian's three month holiday.
The kitchen assistant vacancy advert has now been posted (confirmed by Kaitlin Docherty); Ziang Lin stressed planning ahead for busy periods and not panic hiring or onboarding unqualified candidates.

Staffing is also short because one team member works only 20 hours; Kei Cannon recommended Dagenham and Barking Council as a free recruitment source that sends CVs directly and works better than Talent Funnel.
Saturdays are busy all day with a service gap between 3pm and 6pm, so fresh staff must start at 2pm, 3pm or 4pm to cover breaks rather than the same six people working the whole day.
Staff from Shoreditch or Lakeside who want extra Saturday hours can be redirected to Soho.

The dishwasher area leak persists; Ross is completing the door stoppers and the Zen garden pest job on 13/10, with the VIP section used instead of the Zen garden meanwhile, and Francesca has been sent a video of the ramen section pipe issue.
The cleaners' next visits are 20/10 and 24/11; until then FOH must empty the overflowing toilet bins weekly.
On 13/10 maggots dropping from the ceiling forced half of the restaurant to close, and Kaitlin Docherty was heading to the site that evening.

Kei Cannon flagged that the AM dashboard showed wrong figures (very low labour efficiency) for Lakeside, Soho and Shoreditch; Kaitlin Docherty said the variance reports were filled in late on Sunday night and corrected on Monday morning, and the dashboard will reload overnight.

Region: Ziang Lin introduced a mandatory seating upsell at all sites from 13/10: staff place the drinks menu from the marketing stand in the middle of the table and immediately offer edamame, and kitchens boil a large batch of edamame in advance so it can be blanched for five seconds when ordered.
Region: Kaitlin Docherty will send daily delivery performance (red, amber, green) to the group chats every day between 10:30 and 12:00 from 14/10.
Saturday took over £10,700 net and £12,000 gross (AM Updates 14/10).
Widening the delivery radius from 5 to 20 miles and stabilising the delivery station doubled weekly delivery sales, with around 20 orders a day and 25 delivery stars (AM Updates 14/10).

Wage revenue was 24.29%, which Ziang Lin called efficient given the heavy discounting, and food cost rose because the site kept full stock so out of stock items would not auto reject delivery orders (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: Soho and Shoreditch have a temporary 25% wage revenue target for the next six weeks while heavy promotions run; other sites keep their current targets (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: a level 8 Halloween ramen with a super spicy factory chilli paste is launching with a video; one bag per site, about a teaspoon per bowl (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: snooze out of stock items on both Deliverect and the POS, or the whole delivery order fails (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: wage revenue baseline is 21% with up to 2% leeway; drinks cost moves to management, food cost to head chefs, new OKRs due end of November (AM Updates 14/10).
Region: a temporary reserve stock buffer (about £300) was agreed for the English sites to stop stockouts (AM Updates 14/10).
